bloc.Base figée du dispositif : ces référence: Frozen base of the framework: these references are never generated. Each entry links to its official source — EUR-Lex for European texts, Légifrance for French texts — because an analysis is only worth something if you can trace it back to the text.
bloc.Cadre normatif — IA Act · RGPD · ISO/IEC: Regulatory landscape — AI Act · GDPR · ISO/IEC # · CRA
bloc.Ce qui fait basculer n'est pas votre niv: What tips you over is not your level of security. It is the sector (Annex I or II) and size. A company in Annex I that grows from # to # people becomes an essential entity without having changed anything about its risk — and inherits regular audits and a penalty tier # % higher.
bloc.Cette qualification suit ce que vous déc: This qualification follows what you declare. It is determined in law by the competent national authority, on the actual entity. And it is not something you apply for: the State draws up the list (art. #(#)) and the entity registers itself on it (art. #(#)) — by # April # at the latest.
bloc.Chaque exigence porte son fondement : c': Each requirement carries its basis: that is what lets you defend it in negotiation — and drop it knowingly when it has none. Square brackets mark the values still to be decided.
bloc.ISO/IEC # fournit le système de manageme: ISO/IEC # provides the management system; the AI Act, the GDPR and the CRA supply its regulatory requirements. The same module therefore often serves several frameworks at once — but not always: a dash in a column means that this framework says nothing about this module, and that is information, not a forgotten box. The three frameworks count three different units of analysis — AI systems, processing activities, products — and that is why the CRA has its own register rather than a column in the AI Act one.
bloc.L'assiette est le chiffre d'affaires mon: The base is the total worldwide turnover of the company to which the entity belongs — not that of the subsidiary concerned alone. Reading the subsidiary’s figure divides the exposure by the gap between the subsidiary and the group: it is the largest possible source of error in this calculation.
bloc.La preuve attendue pour la formation des: The evidence expected for managers’ training is named and dated, and it concerns the members of the management body themselves. A company training plan, however complete, does not establish it.
bloc.La réponse suit une trame imposée : qual: The answer follows a set structure: qualification, applicable texts, possible readings with their consequences, risk, a recommendation that takes a position, actions, then reservations. The profile entered in step # is carried over and narrows the scope of the texts.
bloc.Le contrat est confronté à la grille fer: The contract is checked against the closed grid of the clause library, point by point: present, partial or absent, with the exact quotation of the clause concerned. The document is analysed in memory and is not kept — neither stored nor indexed.
bloc.Le rattachement est calculé par des règl: The link to each text is computed by explicit rules, without artificial intelligence: two runs on the same profile give the same result, and each text included shows why it is included. What the questionnaire cannot decide on its own is flagged “to be confirmed” rather than guessed.
bloc.Le référentiel ouvre lui-même deux voies: The framework itself opens two routes of evidence, and it sets limits on them: an ISMS certified to ISO/IEC #:# counts for objectives # and #, but only for the systems covered by the certification; a PACS qualified by ANSSI counts for objective #, provided the entity follows the treatment plan.
bloc.Le taux affiché est un taux de préparati: The rate shown is a readiness rate, never a compliance rate, and it enters no consolidated index. The framework it measures is a working document attached to a bill not yet passed: scoring compliance against a text that does not yet exist would produce a figure that appears to measure something other than what it measures.
bloc.Le verrou de périmètre, et il se contour: The scope blocker, and one word gets round it. The objectives apply to all systems. An exclusion is admissible only if a risk analysis shows that the system is exposed to none of the three named risks — and the framework adds that the presence of security measures is not a justification. “It is segregated, so it is out of scope” is refused in so many words.
bloc.Les cinq lignes ne pèsent pas pareil. Qu: The five lines do not weigh the same. Four are obligations; staff training is an encouragement. A company that trains all its teams except its board has missed the only one of the two training requirements that is mandatory — and it is the one that exposes someone personally.
bloc.Les pièces désignées sont lues intégrale: The designated documents are read in full, not searched by similarity — when you submit a contract to a committee, you want the document, not the three most similar passages.
bloc.Ne pas lire NIS # comme le CRA. Le règle: Do not read NIS # like the CRA. Regulation (EU) #/# is directly applicable: its amounts are the amounts. NIS # is a directive — treating the two the same way underestimates the exposure.
bloc.Pour une réunion de direction ou une nég: For an executive meeting or a negotiation. Three things are produced, and only one comes from the model: the routing — who decides, who is consulted — is computed by rules, because when a text reserves a decision to a body, departing from it is a breach and not an organisational choice; the regulatory deadlines drive the timetable; the summary, the options and the recommendation are drafted solely from the documents provided.
bloc.Profil non renseigné. Le routage se dédu: Profile not provided. Routing is deduced from your sector, your size and your roles: without them, the engine cannot know that a decision must go up to the management body rather than to the legal department. Fill in tab # · Qualification — the note is still produced, but its routing will be generic.
bloc.Services numériques, cybersécurité IT /: Digital services, IT / OT / ICS cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and supplier contracts. A regulatory qualification computed by explicit rules — without AI, and therefore reproducible — followed by an analysis that sets out the possible readings of a text rather than a single answer.
bloc.Un prestataire de services de confiance: A trust service provider notifies incidents affecting its trust services within # hours, not #. And if the incident is still ongoing at the time of the final report, a progress report replaces it, with the final report following one month after the incident has been handled.

texte.Le référentiel de la directive est momen: The Directive’s framework is temporarily unavailable. Nothing is displayed rather than a partial list: for a regulatory text, a truncated list that does not say it is truncated is worth less than no list at all.
texte.Méthodologie : le besoin d'AIPD est prés: Methodology: a DPIA is presumed to be required as soon as two of the CNIL’s nine criteria are met, or in the cases of Article #(#). Risks are assessed by the severity and likelihood of three feared events — illegitimate access, unwanted modification, disappearance of data — on the CNIL scale. Decision aid: a formal DPIA must be documented and, where applicable, submitted to the CNIL under Article #. CONSEILPREV can support you in carrying it out.
